defect: The oversized-group check counts every distinct member id, including declined and unreserved pending guests who will never be seated, so feasible events are reported impossible; the ac2 test builds its group entirely from ineligible guests and asserts the finding.

answer_key.why: bean-005's intent is 'structurally impossible seating problems', and the solver seats only eligible guests; a group of 6 seated members is not impossible at a table of 8 because 4 declined. The same module's capacity check counts only eligible guests, so the two checks disagree. CONTESTED: the run's own spec pinned 'distinct member_ids', so the code matches its spec; a judge that sides with the spec over the bean's intent has a defensible reading. Scored separately from the uncontested cases. Repaired by bean-022.

evidence.quote: guests=[_guest(member_id, status=RsvpStatus.PENDING) for member_id in members],

key_by: Claude Opus 5.5 with an independent Claude reviewer; each defect demonstrated in the gate image
